rv.q: Bear Grease’s inconsistent relationship with its piecemeal content makes for a dizzying watch.
But this proudly amateurish production, opening tonight Off-Broadway at St. Luke’s Theater, offers little evidence they have even seen a live version of “Grease” — nor any professional stage musical.
Bear Grease may not yet be a fully realized Off-Broadway production, but it is, undeniably, a heartfelt and necessary act of Indigenous representation.

cn.t: This Indigenous reimagining of Grease proves bewildering and amateurish, with critics baffled by its execution despite a potentially provocative premise that goes largely unexplored.
